quest.title: In the Aftermath
quest.description: Huffman has his hands full with the cleanup work that followed the storm...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x100, Mora x20000, Guide to Ballad x1

talks.objective: Patrol the area and clear any obstacles
Defeat all opponents and clear the obstacles
Patrol the area and clear any obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: *sigh* If we just had a couple more people on hand...

choices.text: What are the other knights doing?

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Maintaining the city's defenses, helping with the rebuilding effort, and a whole host of other odd jobs.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Every last knight we have is up to their eyeballs in work right now.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: For once, guard duty at the main gate is the relatively easy job.

choices.text: You could solicit help from the Adventurers' Guild.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: In fact, we're lucky to have had their assistance from the outset. At first, they were helping find and rescue victims in the city, more recently they've been keeping watch on monster activity further afield.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: When the monsters began gathering near to the city, it was thanks to the adventurers who carried out early reconnaissance and reported back to us that we were able to make specific and effective plans for the defense effort.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: Even now, they are hard at work supporting all our efforts to get the city back on its feet. Honestly, without them, the Knights would be starting to crumble under the load.

response.speaker: Huffman
response.text: I must make time to thank Cyrus properly...

talks.objective: Defeat all opponents and dismantle their camp

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He wasn't kidding, look at all this junk. Worst thing in the world for foot traffic...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's smash them all to pieces!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's still more? How'd they put up all these in such a short time, anyway?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ugh, what does it matter. Let's clear them all up, then we won't have to think about it any longer.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There are soooo many! Geez, how long were they planning this for?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Not long enough, clearly! The last traces of their big master plan are disappearing right before Paimon's very eyes!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Come on, let's clean this area up, pronto!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Alrighty, our work here is done. Let's go speak to Huffman again.

talks.objective: Patrol the area and clear any obstacles

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: How's your progress? Finished clearing the area yet?

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Fantastic. You've been an enormous help, who knows how much longer those ugly things would've been stood there otherwise...

dialogues.speaker: Huffman
dialogues.text: Honorary Knight, please accept these as an expression of my gratitude.
